articles.title: Collective Health Implements Data-Driven Strategy to Manage Rising GLP-1 Costs
articles.summary: Collective Health has introduced a new analytical approach aimed at helping self-funded employers control the escalating expenditures associated with popular GLP-1 weight-loss medications. This development matters because high-cost specialty drugs like GLP-1s present a severe financial challenge for self-funded plans trying to balance robust employee benefits with fiscal sustainability. For the broader industry, this highlights an urgent market demand for sophisticated data analytics and targeted management solutions to curb unsustainable pharmacy trend.
